probes.finding: Second init exported to the new exporter

findings.title: Source is 0.1.4 but PyPI can remain at 0.1.3 until publish is executed
findings.recommendation: After review, create tag v0.1.4 and publish through the hardened Trusted Publishing workflow; keep git/local install guidance until PyPI is current.

findings.title: Tenant-scoped constraints protect new schemas only
findings.recommendation: Add an Alembic migration in the next storage-focused cycle before applying these constraints to existing production databases.

findings.title: pip-audit cannot audit unpublished local package names themselves
findings.recommendation: Treat the current audit as dependency coverage; after publishing 0.1.4, rerun pip-audit against PyPI-installed artifacts.

aspects.name: Tests and local gate
aspects.note: Pytest, Ruff, mypy, pip check, pip-audit, and release gate are evaluated locally.

aspects.name: Runtime correctness
aspects.note: External-provider reinit, OpenInference metadata, and tenant-attribute probes are regression gates.

aspects.name: Tenant isolation
aspects.note: Tenant IDs share one sanitization helper across context, span attributes, Celery kwargs, and exporters.

aspects.name: Release safety
aspects.note: Publish now depends on release_gate, tag/version validation, twine checks, and Trusted Publishing.

aspects.name: Supply chain
aspects.note: GitHub Actions and reusable workflows are pinned by SHA; dependency audit is blocking.

aspects.name: Docs and adoption
aspects.note: README, FastAPI, Celery, LangChain, and custom exporter examples now match the implemented API.

aspects.name: Harness readiness
aspects.note: Codex context, agents, skill, MCP config, probes, reports, and dashboard are present.
